create.name: Suzi Tucker
create.bio:
Suzi Tucker is an American teacher, facilitator and writer in Family Constellation, a systemic way of looking at how the patterns of a family and its generations live on in each person's choices and relationships. She came to the work through publishing: in 1998 she co-founded the press Zeig, Tucker & Theisen with Jeffrey K. Zeig, and as its editor she received an early manuscript of Bert Hellinger's Love's Hidden Symmetry. She went on to help bring most of Hellinger's English-language books into print and, with Harald Hohnen, set up the Bert Hellinger Institute in the United States, before developing a voice of her own beyond the method's origins.

Today she trains new facilitators through a sixteen-month course that meets in New York and on Zoom, runs supervision for practitioners and a writing group, and gives weekend presentations online on themes such as boundaries, guilt and the dreams we inherit from others. She also leads constellation days in New York and Washington, and residential programmes at places such as the Sivananda Ashram in the Bahamas and the Omega Institute. Her books include the essay collection Gather Enough Fireflies and Take Every Step, a guide to the art and practice of constellation work for students. She is based in Connecticut.

books.title: Gather Enough Fireflies
books.author: Suzi Tucker
books.description: A collection of short reflective prompts on ordinary life, from raising children to facing death. Tucker writes as a systemic thinker but keeps the method in the background, letting the questions do the work.

books.title: Take Every Step: The Art and Practice of Family Constellation
books.author: Suzi Tucker
books.description: Written with her students in mind, this book looks at the deeper layers of constellation work rather than step-by-step technique. It is meant for newer facilitators and for general readers curious about a gentler, more systemic way of seeing their lives.

courses.title: Boundaries and Love (Experiential Conversations)
courses.description: A two-session online presentation over a weekend on why boundaries are hard to hold, especially within families. Tucker traces where guilt and fear first take hold and works on language that leaves room for both love and freedom. Sessions are recorded and available for three weeks.

courses.title: Daydream Interpretation (Experiential Conversations)
courses.description: A weekend presentation on Zoom about the hopes we carry that were not really ours to begin with, and how they shape our sense of success and failure. Two two-hour sessions, recorded for those who cannot attend live.

courses.title: The NYC Constellation Studio
courses.description: Two full days in Manhattan for new and experienced constellation facilitators and committed students. Participants practise together, bring their own personal and professional questions, and work with exercises Tucker offers along the way.

courses.title: Family Constellations: Your Voice is A Chorus
courses.description: A four-day residential programme at the Sivananda Ashram Yoga Retreat on Paradise Island, Bahamas. Using constellation work, the group explores how stories handed down through a family show up in present-day relationships and work. Tuition is shown; lodging is booked separately.

courses.title: Family Constellations: Whose Life Is This Anyway?
courses.description: A one-day in-person workshop at the New Center for Holistic Learning in Manhattan, using constellations to look at which parts of the life we live were handed to us. The same day runs again on 6 February 2027.
